summary.headline: Canara Robeco AMC Q2 FY27 revenue from operations rose 17% YoY to INR 121.6 crores and PAT rose 21% to INR 59.2 crores.
summary.overview:
Q2 FY27 revenue from operations grew 17% YoY to INR 121.6 crores and PAT grew 21% to INR 59.2 crores, with H1 PAT up 23% to INR 134.8 crores. Closing AUM was INR 1.17 lakh crores, with September quarterly average AUM up 4% YoY, while management described the quarter as challenged by a roughly 6% Nifty fall in September. The company declared an interim dividend of INR 2 per share. Management did not disclose net flows, and analysts questioned SIP book and folio trends, which management attributed to ELSS tax-law changes, vintage SIP maturities, and market-driven closures.</overview>

<qa_highlights>[{"question":"Is net inflow data being disclosed, and are net flows negative based on public data?","answer":"Management said it follows industry disclosure standards and is not disclosing net flows at this time."},{"question":"Why is SIP book shrinking in accounts and folios while industry SIP book rises?","answer":"Management cited ELSS (Tax Saver) tax-benefit changes, SIP maturities of vintage funds and market-volatility closures; SIP AUM value still rose to about INR 41,000 crores."},{"question":"Why has ELSS SIP flow declined and what share of SIP is ELSS?","answer":"Management said ELSS data is not public and acknowledged industry-wide impact from tax changes on folio and SIP counts."},{"question":"What is the segment-wise yield and why did yield expand 4-5 bps?","answer":"CFO-equivalent Atit Turakhiya said blended yield was 37-38 bps, equity about 40 bps, fixed income about 28 bps, and liquid about 2 bps."},{"question":"Why was other income INR 29 crores last quarter and how will it evolve?","answer":"Management said other income mainly reflects mark-to-market on about INR 110 crores of mandatory skin-in-the-game capital, which is 90% equity and will vary quarterly."},{"question":"Will commission rationalisation or yield pass-through continue?","answer":"Management said it is comfortable with 35-40 bps, prioritises growth and volumes over yield, and is happy with current distributor structures."},{"question":"Is net equity inflow flat in Q2?","answer":"Management declined to give net flow data, saying it is not in the public domain, and said flows are concentrated in selective products across the industry."}]</qa_highlights>
<risks_watch">["Continued SIP book and folio decline, particularly in ELSS after tax-law change and vintage SIP maturities.","Equity-heavy AUM (about 91%) leaves revenue exposed to market drawdowns; September Nifty fell about 6%.","Regulatory approvals required for planned product launches and NFOs.","Overlap-limit regulation may affect equity scheme performance and inflow cyclicality, per analyst question; management said the equity team is reviewing it.","Share of fund quartile rankings has fallen for some top schemes; management expects recovery but gave no timeline."]</risks_watch>
<management_tone">["Confident on long-term structural growth and profitability; defensive on flows and SIP trends, repeatedly declining to disclose net flow, SIP attrition and ELSS data."]</management_tone>
<key_quotes">["Our market share continues to be stable around the 2% mark.","So, clearly, we've you know, despite the huge volatility, the company has inherent strengths and has delivered a very strong performance.","We would rather focus on growth and additional volumes than focus solely on yields."]</key_quotes>
